_note: Single source of truth for Line of Command V1 balance numbers. spec.md quotes these values; if they disagree, this file wins and spec.md is the bug.
variant_pick: variant index = hash(seed, tick, event_index) mod variant_count

placeholders.counter_reason: not a log placeholder; formations.counter_reasons is UI text

battle_start: Dawn over the {terrain_name}. {a_officer} and {b_officer} take the field.
advance: {side_name} advance. The lines are {distance} hundred paces apart.
Drums beat; {side_name} close to {distance} hundred paces.
cannon: Round shot from {side_name} tears into the ranks: {casualties} down.
canister: Canister at close range! {casualties} fall before {side_name}'s guns.
charge: Sabres flash as {side_name}'s horse crash in: {casualties} fall.
melee: Hand to hand along the line: {casualties} fall to {side_name}.
morale_shaken: Men in {side_name}'s ranks look over their shoulders.
messenger_sent: A rider leaves the general's tent for {officer}.
The general sends a messenger to {officer}.
messenger_sent_standing_order: As ordered before the battle, a rider gallops to {officer}.
rally: The messenger arrives: {officer} rides the line. +{morale_gain} morale (now {morale}), and the men will hold steadier for 2 turns.
'Hold, lads!' {side_name} rally: +{morale_gain} morale (now {morale}); losses will shake them less for 2 turns.
rally_ui_label: Rally: restores 12% of morale lost so far (more with high Inspiration) and cuts morale loss by 10% for 2 turns.
reserves_committed: Reserves march in on {side_name}'s flank: {reserve_troops} fresh men.
auto_reserves: {officer} sends in the reserve on his own judgement.
messenger_wasted: The messenger arrives, but there is nothing left to send.
messenger_lost: The rider never reaches {officer}: the battle is already over.
standing_order_cancelled: The general's standing order is cancelled; a rider has already gone.
live_click_ignored: A second rider is held back; the messenger has already gone.
pursuit: {side_name}'s cavalry ride down the fugitives: {casualties} more fall.
battle_end_win: Victory for {winner_name} after {ticks} turns. {winner_troops} remain against {loser_troops}.
briefing_standard: {general}: The Reds are pressing at {location}. Hold them there, {rank}.
{general}: I need {location} by nightfall. Take it, {rank}.
{general}: Scouts report a column near {location}. Meet it and break it.
briefing_scenario: {general}: {location} must not fall. Their whole column outnumbers you three to one; only its vanguard can reach the walls today. Hold for twelve turns.
{general}: The garrison at {location} is all we have. Forts like it have been stormed at six to one. Make them pay for every yard.
location_won: {location} is ours. The Blues' colours go up.
location_lost: {location} is lost. The Reds' colours fly there tonight.
scenario_held: The walls held. After {ticks} turns {winner_name} still stands, and the column draws off.
Turn {ticks}: {winner_name} has held the fort. The attack is spent.
The vanguard is broken before the walls after {ticks} turns; the rest of the column will not try again today.
scenario_losses_reached: {loser_name} has lost too many men before the walls ({loss_pct}%). The assault is called off.
The ditch is full of {loser_name}'s dead ({loss_pct}% lost). They fall back.
battle_end_draw: Dusk ends the fighting. Neither side can claim the field.
